name: docstruct
description: DocStruct - a project-centric document management and review platform (Mini Project PR1, SPIT 2026-27)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @docstruct/shared && npm run build -w @docstruct/api && npm run build -w @docstruct/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @docstruct/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
